feedback: Iteration 0 has no race telemetry yet, so there is no earlier outcome to cite for or against this candidate. I checked it against the public contract and it is valid: all five sensor positions are inside the allowed x and y ranges, sensor_size 0.012 is an allowed option, the five sensor_weights are inside [-2, 2] and antisymmetric, base_speed 1.4 is inside [0.05, 2], and line_loss 'last_direction' is an allowed option. Nothing in the file is obviously broken. This is the first race, so its main value is telemetry. Once the race reports back, the Optimizer should treat the results as the basis for the next revision. If max_error or line_loss_events are high on the slalom, lower base_speed (for example to 1.2) before changing the controller. If steering_oscillation is high, raise kd (for example to 0.5). If rms_error is high with few line losses, raise kp (for example to 3.0). Keep ki at 0 unless the telemetry shows a steady offset on one side of the course.
requested_changes: After the race: if line_loss_events or max_error are high on the slalom, reduce controller.base_speed (e.g. 1.4 to 1.2) and re-check completion_time, since the 3.0 s limit needs an average near 1.5 m/s.
After the race: if steering_oscillation is high, increase controller.kd (e.g. 0.3 to 0.5) before changing kp.
After the race: if rms_error is high without line losses, increase controller.kp (e.g. 2.5 to 3.0) and keep ki at 0 unless a one-sided offset appears.
